description: This file defines the TypeCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing type information within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace. It includes methods for writing and reading type data with versioning, caching, and type parsing functionalities.

classes.name: TypeCodec
classes.description: A sealed class providing methods for serializing and deserializing type information, including versioning, caching, and type parsing.

classes.name: TypeCodec.TypeKey
classes.description: An internal struct representing a type's name and hash code used for serialization and cache lookups.

methods.name: WriteLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Serializes a type with a length prefix into a buffer writer.

methods.name: WriteEncodedType
methods.description: Serializes a type with version, hash code, and length-prefixed type name.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read a type from a reader, using cache and type conversion.

methods.name: ReadLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed type from a reader.

methods.name: TryReadForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads a type for diagnostics, providing type object and string representation.

methods.name: ThrowUnsupportedVersion
methods.description: Throws an exception for unsupported version numbers.
